reason: I already pay my agency to handle Instagram and the influencer posts, so I don't want to pick creators, pay them on UPI and tap +1 at the reception desk myself. Free pilot or not, my time and my front-desk staff's attention cost more than the fee.
objection: My receptionist is busy with bookings and walk-ins; nobody is going to remember to tap a counter for every promo code, so the numbers will be wrong anyway. Plus I've been pitched by three influencer agencies this year and they all promised 'real customers'.
would_change_my_mind: If the code could be logged automatically when a client books an appointment, and a salon owner I know showed me actual bookings that came from it, I'd try one deal.
